summary: Brookfield Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a reset dividend rate on its Series 24 preference shares and a conversion offer into Series 25 floating-rate shares for the five-year period starting July 1, 2026. The fixed quarterly dividend is set at 5.432% annual rate ($0.3395/share/quarter). Holders may convert on a one-for-one basis into Series 25 shares with a floating rate of 2.30% over 3-month Gov't of Canada T-bills. Automatic conversion triggers apply if fewer than 1,000,000 shares remain outstanding. This is a routine non-event preference share reset and conversion notice, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K for a dividend rate reset, not a special situation.
